title: Digits into a number
prompt: Three single digits arrive in order: first, second, third. Return the three-digit number they make, so digits_to_number(1, 2, 3) is 123.
starter:
func digits_to_number(first, second, third):
	return first + second + third
hints: The first digit is worth a hundred times itself, the second ten times.
solution:
func digits_to_number(first, second, third):
	return first * 100 + second * 10 + third
